name: BeneBot
tagline: Explains the benefits you are entitled to, in plain language
description: Benefits schemes are written in a register designed to be skimmed past. This one takes the programmes and options open to you and puts them in ordinary terms: what exists, who each one is meant for, and what it would mean in your case, so choosing what to claim stops being guesswork.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
